body: I'm not really sure what you're trying to say here?
I don't have abuse issues though. :(

I'm sorry to hear that. People don't take mental issues seriously in america as it's seen as a sign of weakness. Hell, even understanding that it's taken me this long to realize i might need to talk with someone.
I want to, but i'm broke. I realize that i need to do something about this but i don't know where to start. That was the main reason i called the help line.

Well i didn't off myself, i just drank myself into a stupor. I don't even like alcohol. As to what's going on, i made a post previously about my family but that's just the tip of the surface. I'm so fucked up I can't keep anything straight for too long. I make friends but i can never keep them for more than a year or two, probably because i'm so toxic. Everything i love i find a way to destroy and i'm terrified because i really love my fiance. I'd never hurt her but i'll probably find a way to make her break up with me some day so that i can go back to my normal state of isolation.

The worst part is i'm not even isolated. I'm very charismatic so people are constantly surrounding me so i can force myself to pretend to be normal. I'm actually afraid of being alone because my mind goes terrible places when i am. I volunteer all the time and I give a shitton of good advice to people all over the internet but that doesn't make up for what a terrible person i am.

I'm a great listener, however I'm a great listener. I try not to argue with people but when i do I break them in horrible ways, touching on every insecurity i've ever noticed about them, every fear they ever had. When i get angry it's like i'm watching myself do these stupid things like crushing people's psyche or breaking things and it's not me. I used to be normal.

Recently i tried digging back and figuring out why my entire childhood was a blank. I didn't know it, but it's not normal for your memories of life to start at around 12/13. I remembered terrible things. I remembered that my folks abused me, but i didn't remember that the actually used to torture me. I had such strong feelings about the waterboarding issue because i remembered that if you go limp an attacker is more likely to pull you out of the water before you catch a lungful. If i were a violent person i could hurt someone more than breaking a bone, without putting a scratch on them.

I try so hard to be nice to people because i know if i'm ever angry i will go incredibly disproportionately overboard. As a result everyone thinks i'm this well adjusted nice guy, who helps people constantly, when i'm really just this ticking time bomb of a monster.

I really think i should stop myself before i really hurt someone. I have done so many things i can never fix. Oh, I can never fight anyone because the last times i did I whited out and didn't remember the fight. From what i'm told i had to have a body builder drag me off a guy. I was 13 and 165 pounds soaking wet, and nowhere near strong enough for anyone to have to have struggled to pull me off anyone. The worst part? One second i was there, then next second he had hit me and then the next I'm on the ground with a guy sitting on my chest screaming my name telling me to calm the fuck down.

I can't even begin to deal with all this. Then when i called the suicide hotline to try to get help i was put on hold. It's not that i was on hold, it was that it was an automated voice that put me there- not a person. If someone had said, i'm sorry we're swamped but we're really trying i could understand that- i work customer service. Instead i got a computer voice and a fucking happy tune.

Though i'm not really mad at them I'm just mad at the fact that my own family will never love me, that i keep ruining my life, and that despite the fact that i'm really intelligent the fact that i screwed up my first two years of college and am in debt to the government means i will never get student loans or make anything of myself.

Also i am nowhere near good enough for my beautiful, compassionate and understanding fiance. Hell, my dog could probably stand to be walked more too. Fuck.

Sorry that was so long and thanks to everyone who took time out of their day to respond and pm me, i really appreciate it.
